Ps.While some of C. Shy's BL vampires look great, for example some
gargoyles, George Frederick & Reg Driscoll just make me cry. George is
clearly Ambrosio the Thumb (with hair and bigger nose), while Reg
looks like Augustus Giovanni after a short swim in the Canals of
Venice!

It seems that the story goes like this: George is Ambrosio L.Moncada,
first killed by Lucita, and then Daemonically possessed by Reg, (who
is really Augustus, the Secret Puppet Master behind the Samedi)! Maybe
Silvia G. or Andrea G. has fleshcrafted poor Ambrosio, too. And now
The not-so-big-anymore Ambrosio is Camarilla vampire, spying to his
new master.

Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
"Sorrow" <jcb...@yahoo.com> wrote in message news:<LzOP7.13$uw....@newshog.newsread.com>...
> I cannot believe that people think this guy [Shy] has talent.

I'm delighted by Shy’s artwork on crypt cards. His vampires look
like vampires: ageless, sinister and corpselike, yet with a sort of
tainted beauty. I love the gray washes, exotic features and glassy
eyes. And I appreciate most of all the subtlety of expression on his
vampires' faces. He gives the game a touch of class. I hope Whitewolf
will continue to use him for the majority of the crypt cards.
